title: Proceedings Eighth International Conference on Applied Category Theory
summary: The Eighth International Conference on Applied Category Theory took place at the University of Florida on June 2-6 2025. The conference consisted of 2 plenary invited talks, 28 contributed talks, an online community meeting, a general community meeting, and 4 talks by junior researchers who attended the Adjoint School to present the results of their research at the school. Information regarding the conference may be found at https://gataslab.org/act2025/act2025.html. Submission to ACT2025 had three tracks: extended abstracts, software demonstrations, and proceedings.
